items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: I was with Happy Cook and Little Chink Martin, Charlie DuPont, Harry Shields. When we were playing at a gambling place...

ctx.x: And me in here and Sharky and Monk, Chink, Santo, and Lester Bouchon.

So your picture's above Johnny Wiggs' picture there, I see. Yeah. In the book. Yeah. Rose and Sue Shon. Anyway, you said you played at the Palmer House in Chicago. Well, with Sharky. And here in New Orleans, where did y'all play? I'm trying to think.

items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: Little Chink Martin, Roger Johnson, Arthur Selig Jr. I just understand that he just lost his job, you know. He was night manager for the Bourbon Orleans Hotel.

ctx.x: Little Chink Martin, Roger Johnson, Arthur Selig Jr. I just understand that he just lost his job, you know. He was night manager for the Bourbon Orleans Hotel.
